$comment: Machine-readable tool registry (PLAN_PROD_V1 P1). Safety classes drive the ops-console run-button policy: pure=no sockets, offline=localhost mocks only, network_read=real Kalshi read-only, live_order=transmits/mutates (NEVER runnable from the console). Ambiguous rounds UP. pass_token is the display string a run-button greps for; exit code is authoritative. Validated by tools/check_registry.py in `make check`.

tools.name: test_gold_load
tools.description: W2.1: typed loaders — V1 byte-exact E4 round-trip on real golden rows, no-float-parse grep gate, §2.2 validation gates proven red on seeded-defect fixtures, trade sort+dedupe, quarantine+loader report

tools.name: test_gold_fsm
tools.description: W2.2: book FSM — pure per-market state machine (snapshot/delta/invalid/crossed/seq-gap/heartbeat), invalid-until-snapshot no-clamp latch, yes-space transform, DEPTH+rest aggregation, both seq modes; clamp-bug + stale-state-after-invalid seeded fixtures proven red by mutation

tools.name: test_gold_merge
tools.description: W2.3: merge iterator — global k-way total order (ts_us, TRADE<BOOK_DELTA at equal µs, source file order), dense 0-based stream_seq, per-market gap-free book_seq minting, trades reference only already-emitted book state (structural V3/V6 checkers); same-µs ordering + book_seq-gap seeded fixtures proven red by mutation

tools.name: test_gold_io
tools.description: W2.4: gold writer/reader — merged records -> 512B .bin + markets/trade_ids sidecars + md5 manifest; mmap reader verifies every md5 on open; 10k write->mmap==streamed-parse (V11 runtime half); same-day 1:1 market_id<->ticker = build failure; cross-day access requires ticker (§2.1); fnv1a64 hash<->UUID reconciliation (V8 shape); dup-ticker/dup-id/sidecar-tamper/hash-tamper fixtures proven red by mutation

tools.name: test_gold_validate
tools.description: W2.5: validator harness — V2/V3/V4/V6/V9/V10 run independently over written gold days (+ V8-shape hash reconciliation wired, never dormant); one committed seeded-defect day per check proven red (green/red matrix); failing day -> quarantine move + nonzero exit

tools.name: test_kalshi_golden
tools.description: W3.3: golden Kalshi frames — V13 field semantics on REAL captured frames (1 snapshot + 50 deltas + 50 trades, verbatim): per-sid seq scoping incl. trades carrying seq, trade_id UUID dedupe key, byte-exact E4 fixed-point strings via gold_load, taker_side yes/no, per-channel ts encodings; V12 saved-spec gate skips the module loudly when red/stale; doctored dup-trade_id/seq-regression/float-price fixtures proven red

tools.name: gold_validate
tools.description: W2.5: validate one gold day partition (V2,V3,V4,V6,V8,V9,V10, independent; all violations reported); any failure MOVES the whole partition to <root>/quarantine/date=<D>/ + nonzero exit; derived work/gold data only, never raw/archive

tools.name: gold_build
tools.description: W2.6: build + validate one gold day — thin composition (V12 saved-spec gate -> warehouse load() read-only -> W2.1 loaders + quarantine report -> per-(channel,market) sorted slices -> W2.2/W2.3 FSM+merge -> W2.4 write_day -> W2.5 validate_day; failed day quarantined + nonzero exit; never auto-runs the network spec sync)
